text:
**G1 finding.** The code and specs hold the keep-and-redeliver rule and nothing more. A waiting outbox entry gets none of the four delivery checks the triage names.

ARTIFACT gap_finding: SIL-B19 (`self-improvement.spec.md` l.162-166) says only that on a refusal or unreachable host the payload is kept in `filing-outbox.jsonl` and redelivered with the next filing; one scenario, proved by SIL-AC3. No spec states a delivery check, a comment-instead-of-create rule, a mute drop or an age limit. `max_age_days` appears in no file under `plugins/tempergraph` apart from the triage note, so `outbox.max_age_days` has no parameter record yet; `mute.days` is the model (30, `default_no_data`; loop-issues ISS-B3 l.28 and its ADR; the `improvement-data` parameter rule IMD-AC3). Code (`improve/filing.py`; basis `read`, plus `tested` for plain keep and redeliver): `Outbox` (l.339-360) is a JSONL file with `add` (append) and `take` (read all, unlink, return all, no age or order logic). Entry fields: op `comment`/`create`/`reopen`, repo, number or title/body/labels, `fingerprint`; no timestamp is stored, so age cannot be computed today. `file()` l.443-448 redelivers every taken entry first, unless a dry run, via `_deliver` (l.363-369) with no search of open issues, no mute check and no age check; on `CodeHostError` the entry is re-added, otherwise a result `{op: redelivered, url, fingerprint}` is recorded. The mute and open-issue match (`_match_open` l.396, closed read and mute l.472-487, `_read` retry l.385) run only for new decisions, so a queued create can duplicate an issue filed since. Fresh failures queue `{op: queued}` (l.501-506). Other writers to the outbox: `release.py` `_reopen` l.44-59 (reopen), `cli/improve.py` l.371 (PRP-B25 trial comment); PRP-B25 and PRP-B29 scenarios in `improvement-proposals.spec.md` l.152, 208 and PRP-AC9/AC13 rely on it. Tests: `test_filing.py` l.188 `test_dedup_retry_dry_run_and_outbox`, `test_loop_issues.py` l.467; both assert plain keep and redeliver only. `central-run-stats` CST-B12 (l.92) and TEL-B36/37 are the stats outbox, a different one. Open-issue match rules are in ISS-B7; the cap on "seen again" comments (ISS-B13) is applied to new decisions only.
